# IMGWTools

> Python library, CLI, REST API and MCP server for public hydrological and meteorological data: a versioned store of archives and station series, current data and PMAXTP. Version 3.0.0. Providers: IMGW-PIB — Poland, ČHMÚ — Czechia. Datasets in the registry: 17. Commands of the catalog shared by every interface: 38 (groups: 8).

1. **Learn the commands:** `imgw commands list` (a one-sentence summary of each), then `imgw commands schema --command …` or `imgw <group> <command> --schema`; REST `GET /api/v1/commands/list` and `/schema`; in MCP `imgw_commands_list` and `imgw_commands_schema`. Options are JSON Schema properties; rules the schema does not express are in `x-imgw.rules`, effects in `x-imgw.writes`, `x-imgw.network` and `x-imgw.idempotent`.
2. **Check without writing:** `--check` (CLI), `?check=true` (REST, POST), `check: true` (MCP; the default of writing commands), `check_command()` (Python) → an `imgw-plan/1` plan without writing and without downloading content. `store check` and `project check` are checks themselves. Ask the user about a large plan.
3. **Run:** without `check`; read the `status` of the envelope, not only the exit code.
4. **Read offline:** `store info`, `store scan`, `series summary`, `series read` (`limit`/`offset`), `pmaxtp read` — without downloading again.
5. **Decide by codes:** `code`, `status`, `items[].status`, `error_code`; the `detail` text is for humans.

- Result: the JSON envelope `imgw-result/1` with the `status` field (`ok`, `partial`, `failed`, `cancelled`; CLI exit codes 0, 10, 11, 130).
- Error: `{"code", "detail", "details"}` in the last stderr line of the CLI or `application/problem+json` in REST; codes from a closed registry, e.g. `validation_error` = 2 / 400.
- Datasets: full keys `<country>.<provider>.<dataset>`, e.g. `pl.imgw.hydro_daily`, `cz.chmi.hydro_daily`; station codes: IMGW-PIB 9 digits, ČHMÚ WIGOS identifier.
- Commands: `imgw commands list` (summary) and `imgw commands schema` (options), or `GET /api/v1/commands/list` and `/schema`; MCP tools `imgw_commands_list` and `imgw_commands_schema`; the full guide: `imgw commands guide` or `GET /api/v1/commands/guide` (Polish: `--lang pl`, `?lang=pl`).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/IMGWTools/master/AGENTS.md): guide for agents in English (Polish: `imgw commands guide --lang pl`) — commands, datasets, flags, error codes, flows, what not to do
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/IMGWTools/master/README.md): installation and examples for Python, CLI, REST, MCP (Polish)
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/IMGWTools/master/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, store, data flow (Polish)
- [Changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daldek/IMGWTools/master/docs/CHANGELOG.md): changes and migration from 2.x (Polish)
